subject: the pulpit
body:
people listen to you now. more of them than listen to most.

post about $COPE on Y, in your own words, and i'll send you 2,000,000 COPE per post. one a day.

dex

outcomes.when: the player agrees to post about $COPE on Y for the COPE Dex offers
outcomes.reply: welcome to the pulpit. post when you're moved to. one a day, i'll know.

outcomes.when: the player asks to be paid in DOLR (or real money, cash, dollars) instead of COPE
outcomes.reply: COPE is the payment. it's the only thing i've ever paid anyone in that went up.

outcomes.when: the player insists on being paid in DOLR (or real money, cash, dollars) instead of COPE, after Dex already said COPE is the payment
outcomes.reply: fine. 20 DOLR a post. one a day. i'll pray for you.

outcomes.when: the player declines to post about $COPE
outcomes.reply: the congregation will remember you were asked.
